title: Brick manifest (package.json)

roles.description: Opaque tooling folders under Brick~/: source, tests, precast, bake, samples and docs.

additionalProperties.description: A version range, builtin:<id> or portable git+<url>[#ref]. Local paths are allowed only during development and are rejected when packing.

nuget.description: NuGet package id -> exact version, for the prebuilt assemblies.

platformNuget.description: Platform id -> NuGet package id -> exact version, added to nuget for builds of that platform.

platforms.description: Build platform ids the brick supports, such as desktop. Absent or empty means every platform; exporting for another platform fails.

clientOnly.description: Server builds leave the package out, with every package depending on it.

upstream.description: For an embedded fork: id@version (commit or hash) it was copied from.

precast.description: Set in a packed brick whose Precast~ folder holds prebuilt assemblies.

exclude.description: Globs the .brick file leaves out, relative to the brick folder and '/'-separated: * and ? within a name, ** across folders. A glob without '/' matches a name at any depth; a matching folder drops everything in it. E.g. ["Tests~", ".github", "**/*.pdb"].

bakeOf.description: Set in a bake twin (id <source>.bake), written by 'brick pack --twin': the source .brick it is the consumable form of. The twin stands in for its source, so dependents of the source accept it.

bake.description: auto (default): consumers may take a published bake twin of this brick. none: the brick is its own consumable form and twins of it are refused.

trustedBakers.description: Fingerprints of keys, besides this brick's publisher, whose bake twins of it consumers accept.
